title: Enabling Member Blog Posts and Community Articles Publishing

sections.heading: Member Article Publishing
sections.content:
Members can author and publish blog posts, community articles, classifieds, and events directly from their member dashboard:
1. Navigate to Finance > Membership Plans.
2. Edit the target plan and open the 'Post Publishing' tab.
3. Locate the 'Community Articles / Blog Posts' post type.
4. Set Publishing Permission to 'Can Publish' (or set maximum post limits).
5. When logged into their member dashboard, members click 'Publish Content' > 'Add New Article' to draft and post.

procedural_steps: Edit membership plan and open Post Publishing tab
Enable Community Articles / Blog Posts permission
Set post limits and moderation options
full_text:
Member Article Publishing
Members can author and publish blog posts, community articles, classifieds, and events directly from their member dashboard:
1. Navigate to Finance > Membership Plans.
2. Edit the target plan and open the 'Post Publishing' tab.
3. Locate the 'Community Articles / Blog Posts' post type.
4. Set Publishing Permission to 'Can Publish' (or set maximum post limits).
5. When logged into their member dashboard, members click 'Publish Content' > 'Add New Article' to draft and post.
